C-7.Name: Re-reveal the active tab after tab-strip container resize (ResizeObserver)
C-7.Summary: C-6 scrolls the active tab into view on activation change, reorder, and tab-bar re-show, but a container RESIZE is not a trigger: shrinking the window can clip the active tab off-screen until the next activation (observed live during the CUA QA run: 720→480px resize left the active watch.md tab outside the visible window). Add a ResizeObserver on .scrollable-tabs that runs scrollActiveTabIntoView after width changes, with a zero-width guard for the display:none state.

Problem.Description: After narrowing the window, the active tab can sit off-screen with no indication which tab is active — the exact UX C-6 set out to fix — until the user switches tabs.
Problem.RootCause: No watcher source observes the strip container's geometry; Vue reactivity covers store state, not element size.
Problem.Evidence: CUA QA run 2026-09-16: set_window_frame 720→480px; AX frames showed watch.md at x=906..962 while the visible window ended at 780; the strip corrected only after the next activation event.

Goals.R-1: tabs.vue observes tabContainer with ResizeObserver (guarded for environments without it, e.g. jsdom); on entry width change with clientWidth > 0, run scrollActiveTabIntoView via nextTick; disconnect in onBeforeUnmount.
Goals.R-2: Unit tests with a stubbed ResizeObserver class capture the observer callback and the observed element, simulate width-change entries, and pin: scroll on resize, no scroll on zero-width (display:none), and disconnect on unmount.

Constraints.Constraint: Reuse scrollActiveTabIntoView; no second scroll path.
ResizeObserver is feature-detected, never imported polyfilled.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Observing window resize globally or other elements.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: After any strip resize with a non-zero width, the active tab ends fully visible.
display:none (zero width) never triggers a scroll write.
Renderer suites green; observer disconnected on unmount (no leak).

C-7.VerificationIntent: tests/renderer/components/tabs-scroll.test.js resize cases; CUA live check: shrink the window with an off-edge active tab and confirm the strip re-reveals it without any activation.

Approval.ApprovalScope: Implement with the C-8/C-9 batch; same review + CUA gates.
